L27n2369.name: Name fragments, 'queue' writer
L27n2369.description: Fires on a partial token inside a capitalized name or split word, e.g. 'Stra' in Straits, 'Cr' in Crataegus, 'Caj' in Cajete, just before the word completes. Pushes toward 'queue' and 'que' tokens.

L27n1239.name: Split-word pieces, quote-period
L27n1239.description: Goes strongly negative on a middle or last piece of a split word, e.g. 'id' in Pteridaceae, 'ro' in roselike, 'Man' in Manilkara. Pushes toward closing-quote-period tokens (a quote mark followed by a period).

L27n1206.name: Quantity digits, Greek letters
L27n1206.description: Fires on a digit or symbol inside a number or formula, e.g. the '0' in '250 F' or '10 times', and on name starts like 'Ik'. Pushes toward Greek letters such as gamma, delta, beta and alpha.

L27n2371.name: Piece before 'ps' sound
L27n2371.description: Fires on the piece just before a 'ps' sound, e.g. 'ile' in Epilepsy, 'se' in sepsis, 'ise' in antiseptic, 'cathe' in cathepsin. Pushes toward 'ps' tokens.

L27n538.name: Name fragments, blank output
L27n538.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split name or word, e.g. 'Mack' in Mackinac, 'Ret' in Retriever, 'tam' in tampered. Pushes toward whitespace, so the output goes blank.

L27n469.name: 'con' fragments, acronym letters
L27n469.description: Fires on 'con' starting a word piece (self-concepts, convection, unconsciously) and on first letters of acronyms, e.g. 'W' in WGPSN and 'C' in CPSI. Pushes toward 'dp', 'CP' and 'HP' tokens.

L27n2966.name: Word-start fragments, ui/widget
L27n2966.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, especially 'Hy' in hydrogen and hygiene, and 'dec' or 'disc' in decimation and discursive. Pushes toward 'ui' and 'widget' tokens.

L27n1089.name: Name-start pieces, comma-letter
L27n1089.description: Goes negative on the first consonant-led piece of a split name or word, e.g. 'Sc' in Scelzo, 'Ph' in Phatthalung, 'Sk' in Skopje, 'Rab' in Rabas. Pushes toward a comma followed by a letter, such as ',w' or ',b'.

L27n1119.name: Long-word middles, 'Att' writer
L27n1119.description: Goes negative on the middle piece of a long word, e.g. 'ost' in somatostatin and Ophiostoma, '-ph' in phosphatases, 'istr' in Peisistratus. Pushes toward 'Att' and 'att' tokens, which then repeat in the output.

L27n2821.name: Word-start pieces, 'sheet' writer
L27n2821.description: Fires on the short first piece of a split word, most often 'Fl' (Flanner, flaring, flanged), 'gr' (grubs, grueling) and 'var' (variances). Pushes toward 'sheet' tokens.

L27n1326.name: Piece before '-ac' ending
L27n1326.description: Fires on the piece just before a word-final '-ac' or '-acs' sound, e.g. 'agn' in Armagnac, 'oss' in Cossack, 'ani' in pteridomaniacs. Pushes toward 'ac' tokens.

L27n1166.name: Word-start 'P' and '-p'
L27n1166.description: Fires on a capital 'P' or hyphen-'p' starting a word piece, e.g. 'P' in Puzzles and Punctuality, '-p' in apple-picking and self-published. Also fires on 'og' in aminoglycoside. Pushes toward 'entity' tokens.

L27n713.name: Word pieces, closing brackets
L27n713.description: Goes negative on a piece that starts a new fragment of a split word, e.g. 'ce' in isosceles, 'FA' in FADE IN, 'vert' in vertebrae. Pushes toward closing brackets and braces such as ')' and '}'.

L27n2680.name: Name-start pieces, 'edit' writer
L27n2680.description: Goes negative on the first short piece of a multi-token name or word, e.g. 'Te' in Teesside, 'Therm' in Thermopylae, 'blo' in bloom. Pushes toward 'edit' tokens.

L27n2289.name: Split-name starts, 'assign' writer
L27n2289.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a split name, e.g. 'Zu' in Zuigetsu, 'Vas' in Vasari, 'Hu' in Huizinga, 'gu' in guineensis. Pushes toward 'assign' and 'assignment' tokens.

L27n2726.name: 'cl' onsets, 'borrow' writer
L27n2726.description: Fires on the 'cl' that starts a word piece (clumps, clowns, clenching, clonemates) and on 'rom' or 'om' endings like neuroma and acromegaly. Pushes toward 'borrow' and 'loan' tokens.

L27n2841.name: 'con'/'fl' pieces, 'rot' writer
L27n2841.description: Goes negative on 'con' starting a split word (convection, confederation, unconventional) and on 'fl' in flaky or flaking. Pushes toward 'rot' and 'rotation' tokens.

L27n1655.name: 'sa'/'omat' pieces, 'aut' writer
L27n1655.description: Goes negative on the 'sa' in sauté and the 'omat' in onomatopoeia, plus 'ron' and 'ry' fragments in acronyms and apocryphal. Pushes toward 'aut' and 'auto' tokens.

L27n1311.name: 'd'-prefix pieces, 'div' writer
L27n1311.description: Goes negative on the word piece just before a 'd' or 'div' continuation: 'biod' in biodiversity, 'nond' in nondiscriminatory, 'pred' in prediabetes, '-d' in self-determination. Pushes toward 'div' tokens.

L27n2319.name: Word before 'Administration'
L27n2319.description: Fires on the word just before 'Administration' in agency names: 'Atmospheric' in National Oceanic and Atmospheric, 'Energy' in National Energy, 'Emergency' in Federal Emergency Relief. Pushes toward 'admin' tokens.

L27n892.name: Name-start fragment, writes $
L27n892.description: Fires on the first fragment of a split capitalized name or word, right where it is still incomplete (Tr|ivium, Ste|phen, Sh|iloh, Mer|ck, Rom|mel). Pushes the model toward '$' variable-style tokens; steered output degenerates into '$' spam.

L27n390.name: Name fragment, writes =
L27n390.description: Fires on the first or middle fragment of a proper noun or rare word split into several tokens (Ol|ives, Mes|opotamia, Bre|asted, Stal|ingrad, Wons|an). Pushes toward '=' tokens; steered output spams '=A=B=B'.

L27n1672.name: Title connector word
L27n1672.description: Strongly negative on the function word or capital-letter start inside formal titles and honours (of in Minister of Munitions, the in Order of the Bath, a in Knight of the Garter, G in Gutzon). Pushes toward closing quote-plus-comma or quote-plus-paren tokens; steered output spams those closers and newlines.

L27n277.name: Mid-phrase words, quote closers
L27n277.description: Diffuse: fires on words in the middle of fixed formal phrases where the next word is predictable (with great sadness, come into force, voice and data, does not change, St. Helens). Pushes toward closing curly quotes after sentence punctuation (.” !” ?”); steered output spams those closers.

L27n575.name: Capital-letter word onsets
L27n575.description: Strongly negative on a bare capital-letter start of a split word or name, especially O or R (O|yster, O|steomarkt, O|phthalmology, R|emy, Ul|ster). Pushes toward closing quote-plus-comma tokens; steered output spams them.

L27n2950.name: Surname fragment, writes $
L27n2950.description: Strongly negative on the first or second fragment of a capitalized surname or place name split into tokens (Kepler, Teesside, Leibniz, Thihalolipavan, Ph|ung). Pushes toward '$' tokens, the same write as L27n892+; steered output spams '$'.

L27n1530.name: Predicate-opening words, brackets
L27n1530.description: Fires on a modal, infinitive or linking word that opens a predicate (may, to, be, would, become, being, which, before) in prose and instructions. Pushes toward closing brackets and braces (]] and }}); steered output spams ]].

L27n2231.name: Name fragment, writes pointer
L27n2231.description: Fires on the first fragment of a capitalized name or ethnonym split into tokens (Sl|avic, Kut|cher, Al|fonso, Dev|anand, Hil|figer). Pushes toward 'pointer' and 'ptr' code tokens; steered output spams 'pointer'.

L27n534.name: Rare-word middle fragments
L27n534.description: Strongly negative on a middle or late fragment of a rare, foreign or Latin word split into tokens (mang|ostana, Pseud|omon|as, per|nicious, br|ussels). Pushes toward 'x' tokens (tx, rx, xml); steered output spams 'xox'.

L27n2316.name: Word-start fragment, writes schema
L27n2316.description: Fires on a short word-start fragment that begins a split word and must be completed (contr|ived, nond|iscriminatory, d|icing, de|oxyguanosine). Pushes toward 'schema' and 'scheme' tokens; steered output spams 'schema' or 'scheme'.

L27n1728.name: Consonant-cluster onsets
L27n1728.description: Strongly negative on a word-start consonant-cluster fragment (sm-, sn-, sh-, bl-, Rh-) that begins a split word (Sm|ell, sm|oking, sn|ippers, sh|ark, bl|ower). Pushes toward 'Delta' and 'offset' tokens; steered output spams 'Delta'.

L27n1143.name: Latin species-name fragments
L27n1143.description: Fires on a middle fragment of a Latin, botanical, zoological or drug name split into tokens (Cen|chr|us, Psitt|acula, Phil|adelphus, Syc|amore, Cy|athe|aceae). Pushes toward 'CT' and 'pt' tokens; steered output spams 'CT'.

L27n1324.name: Capital P/Pl name onsets
L27n1324.description: Fires on the first fragment of a capitalized name or place, often a bare P or Pl (Pl|atonist, P|alla, Pum|saint, Gr|ange, Zam|bezi). Pushes toward LaTeX-style brace tokens such as }{ and {; steered output spams '{}{}'.

L27n849.name: Mid-word vowel fragments
L27n849.description: Strongly negative on a middle fragment of a word split into tokens, especially a vowel-ending piece in a rare name (Infl|uen|za, cantal|ou|pe, Zam|be|zi, Leib|n|iz). Pushes toward 'az' and 'AZ' tokens; steered output spams 'Aziz'.

L27n2282.name: Mid-word fragments, writes [
L27n2282.description: Fires on the second piece of a split word or name (As|qu|ith, En|richment, br|uxism, ur|inating), plus some list-number glyphs like ❶. Pushes toward '[' and '][' tokens; steered output spams '[ ]'.

L27n589.name: F/inf letter onsets
L27n589.description: Fires on a word-start 'f', 'F' or 'inf' fragment that begins a split word (F|estival, F|eta, inf|lection, inf|irm, non-F|iction). Pushes toward 'x' tokens such as (x and [x; steered output spams 'x'.

L27n2577.name: -ise/-ize stem fragments
L27n2577.description: Strongly negative on a word stem split into tokens right before an -ise or -ize ending (inc|ision, conc|isely, treat|ise, inc|ised). Pushes toward '-ised', '-ized', '-izing' and '-ization' tokens; steered output spams 'ized'.

L27n2031.name: Technical-word fragments, writes ax
L27n2031.description: Fires on the first or second fragment of a technical or scientific word split into tokens (asymp|totes, inter|posed, gal|actic, Squ|ibb, proph|yl|axis). Pushes toward 'ax' and 'axis' tokens; steered output spams 'Ax'.

L27n2081.name: Word-start m fragments
L27n2081.description: Strongly negative on a bare word-start 'm' or 'M' fragment that begins a split word (M|esoamerica, m|ussels, m|ango, m|ated, ym|ade). Pushes toward 'byte' and 'bytes' tokens; steered output spams 'bytes'.

L27n2123.name: Word-start g fragments
L27n2123.description: Strongly negative on a word-start 'g', 'G' or 'w' fragment, often right after a hyphen (-g|iven, second-g|uess, lace-w|ings, Gu|elph, G|overnor). Pushes toward 'rect' and 'rectangle' tokens; steered output spams 'rect'.

L27n909.name: Word-start fragments
L27n909.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, where the rest of the word is still to come (Tex|ian, Schw|ann, Ost|ereierbaum, cant|aloupe, sw|arms); pushes toward 'beam/bean' tokens, which the reading does not match.

L27n2574.name: Word-internal fragments
L27n2574.description: Negative on word-internal pieces of split words, mostly the middle or end of a word (nemat|oc|ysts, apoc|ryphal, c|asserole, Sarab|hai); pushes toward 'delete' tokens, which the reading does not match.

L27n1804.name: Split name starts
L27n1804.description: Fires on the first piece of a split proper name or technical term, with the rest of the name still to come (Q|al'a, Rad|bod, Sch|ueller, Hal|ch?, Pad|ua-style starts); pushes toward 'dict' tokens.

L27n2999.name: Word before engineering
L27n2999.description: Fires on the modifier right before 'engineering' or 'engine' in technical compounds (Chemical, Biological, Industrial, Systems, genetically, Search Engine Optimization); pushes toward 'engine' tokens.

L27n1975.name: Inner word pieces
L27n1975.description: Negative on inner pieces of split medical and technical words (epid|ermis, trau|ma, dial|ysate, proph|ylaxis, pl|umb line); pushes toward 'pi' tokens, which the reading does not match.

L27n1293.name: Inner name pieces
L27n1293.description: Negative on inner pieces of split names and foreign-script terms (Hojiblanca, Rhododendron, Ibn Rushd, mang|ostana, Fil|adelfia); pushes toward '.js' and 'JavaScript' tokens.

L27n2531.name: Name-start 'Ed' pieces
L27n2531.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalised name or product, most often 'Ed' (Edublogs, Edinburgh, Edexcel, Edsullivan) and 'Jud'; pushes toward 'helper/assistant' tokens.

L27n1758.name: Spine and vertebra words
L27n1758.description: Negative on spine, vertebra and disc words (spinal, vertebral, spine, spinal column), with a smaller cluster on geology words (geologic, water); pushes toward 'column' tokens.

L27n409.name: Later name pieces
L27n409.description: Negative on later pieces of split proper names (Nov|gor|od, Ibn R|ushd, Almohad, Armist|ice, Abu Daw|ud); pushes toward 'PD/MD/SD' abbreviation tokens.

L27n660.name: Inner title pieces
L27n660.description: Negative on inner pieces of split names and titles (Kh|ao, Or|isk|any, Mes|quita, Hot|am|isligil, Nat|ional Park); pushes toward '-C' and '/B' style suffix tokens.

L27n370.name: URL and filename pieces
L27n370.description: Negative on fragments inside URLs, domains and file names (www.dhs.gov, st|aysafeonline, bit|es.com, .w and .s pieces); pushes toward file extensions like .json, .html and .png.

L27n2652.name: Mixed split-word starts
L27n2652.description: Fires on the first piece of split words in mixed text (Sergei Ye|fremov, CRE|ATOR, oxid|ans, Ne|olithic, hydrogen peroxide); pushes toward 'ev/Ev/evolution' tokens, which the reading does not match.

L27n1972.name: Suffix-bound word starts
L27n1972.description: Fires on the first piece of a word that continues with a suffix (emanc|ipated, pard|oned, Cal|iphate, arm|istice, co-oc|curring); pushes toward 'ip/IP' tokens.

L27n614.name: Word starts in lists
L27n614.description: Negative on the first piece of split words in instruction and list text (exc|itable, dri|est, enc|odes, Fr|isia), and on 'bullet points' in the system prompt; pushes toward 'Python' tokens.

L27n2879.name: Short capital word starts
L27n2879.description: Fires on a short one- or two-letter first piece of a word, often a capital (B|abylon, Bl|asco, dr|ab, sc|atters, v|logger); pushes toward 'fiber/fibre' tokens.

L27n876.name: Chemistry word pieces
L27n876.description: Negative on inner pieces of chemistry and technical words (trihal|omethane, photocat|alytic, sil|icon, lact|ose, chlor|oform, antiretrovirals); pushes toward 'de/DE' tokens.

L27n2010.name: Word starts before optim
L27n2010.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word (dise|ased, Astroph|ysics, poly|gamy, lo|aves, Ely|pteridaceae); pushes toward 'opt/optim' tokens, which the reading does not match.

L27n1488.name: Place-name word starts
L27n1488.description: Fires on the first piece of split words, often place and river names (Wollong|ong, Del|ville, Ph|ang?, Mar|quesas, cate|cholamines); pushes toward 'Est/estimate' tokens.

L27n2386.name: Word starts before token
L27n2386.description: Fires on the first piece of split words (apol|ipoprotein, bar|ges, bra|ids, sne|ezing, unequiv|ocal); pushes toward 'token' tokens, which the reading does not match.

L27n417.name: Sarcophagus-style mid-word pieces
L27n417.description: Negative on the 'oph' piece of sarcophagus and other split words (sarc|oph|agus, Pterid|oph|yta, vitil|igo, Crata|egus); pushes toward '(pg' and 'PG' tokens.

L27n2810.name: Mid-word stem before -ul/-ol
L27n2810.description: Stem piece of a word split into tokens, right before an '-ul-'/'-ol-' ending (Im|mac|ulate, co|ag|ulation, α-toc|opher|ol, co|ch|lea). Pushes toward 'ol'/'ul' suffix pieces.

L27n2662.name: Name-initial fragment, Ap/Et
L27n2662.description: First sub-token of a capitalized name or rare word split into pieces (Ap|ocrypha, Et|gar Keret, Ang|olan, Tr|ivium, Ar|bequina). Pushes toward 'implement'-family tokens.

L27n1375.name: Bare 'l' word start
L27n1375.description: A bare 'l' or 'eyel' beginning a word or subword, strongest on 'lizard', 'eyelid', 'lily', 'lice', 'lollies'. Pushes toward 'sl'/'Sl' tokens, which the steered model spams.

L27n183.name: Diacritic vowels in names
L27n183.description: Long vowels and diacritic letters (ā, å, ī, ṛ, ø) inside transliterated Sanskrit, Arabic, or Norwegian words, plus some word-start fragments. Pushes toward 'nya', 'ming', 'la', 'mi' syllable tokens.

L27n2024.name: Mid-word fragment before comp
L27n2024.description: A subword piece in the middle of a long technical or foreign word (pork|chops, enc|hilada, eicosapent|aenoic, un|shunt, dec|imation). Pushes toward 'comp'/'compound' tokens.

L27n1151.name: Capitalized name-start letters
L27n1151.description: The first sub-token of a capitalized proper name (Pannotia, Nakhon, Sita, Sugriva, Kashefi), often a single consonant that opens an unfinished name. Pushes toward '<'-prefixed tokens like '<x', '<v', '<c'.

L27n2028.name: Mid-word piece, long words
L27n2028.description: A middle subword piece of a long Latin or technical word (epider|der|mis, cur|ator, amino|glyc|osides, corn|uc|opia, in|cis|ors). Pushes toward 'publish'-family tokens.

L27n1696.name: Rare-word middle fragment
L27n1696.description: A middle fragment of a rare or Greek/Latin-derived word split into tokens (Rhodod|endron, seb|orrhea, hid|rosis, nit|rate, imet|...). Pushes toward 're'-type tokens such as 'res', 're', 'rend'.

L27n1794.name: Science and place stems
L27n1794.description: Start of a research-field word (archae|ologists, epidemi|ology, ep|igenome, agr|onomist) or of a place name (Arg|onne, Vol|ga, Est|epa). Pushes toward 'gen'/'gene' tokens.

L27n1631.name: Word-start c/rec fragments
L27n1631.description: A 'c' or 'rec'/'sc' onset piece of a word split into subtokens (rec|aptured, under-c|rust, squirrel-c|age, aqua-c|ulture, disc|ernible). Pushes toward 'cap'-family tokens.

L27n1361.name: Place-name first pieces
L27n1361.description: The first sub-token of a place or person name (Kh|ao Luang, Dar| es Salaam, Chi|apas, Nar|ayanganj, Pou|lsbo), usually after 'in', 'of', or 'at'. Pushes toward code and web tokens like 'Db', 'Sql', 'Js', 'Css', 'Html'.

L27n1455.name: s after hyphen
L27n1455.description: The 's' onset of a word piece right after a hyphen or prefix (self-s|acrifice, self-s|ufficiency, quasi-s|culptural, un-s|upervised, Para-S|ummary). Pushes toward 'sup'-family tokens.

L27n2829.name: Word-start S/Sh fragments
L27n2829.description: A word-initial 'S', 'Sh', 'Se', or 'str' piece of a split word or place name (Sw|indon, Se|ville, sh|ui, str|ung, unve|ils, Tr|ang). Pushes toward affix words like 'append', 'supplement', 'prefix'.

L27n1335.name: Word-start p fragments
L27n1335.description: A word-start piece that often begins with 'p' or 'P' (shaded-p|ole, unp|asteurized, P|atches, COMP|ASS, multip|lex). Pushes toward 'pass'-family tokens.

L27n1399.name: Middle of proper-name pieces
L27n1399.description: The middle piece of a multi-token proper name or word (Taj Mah|al, Nau|voo, Ram|khamhaeng, enc|roached, Sar|acen). Pushes toward markdown and symbol tokens such as '*', '#', '`', and '""'.

L27n600.name: Stem before qu sound
L27n600.description: A mid-word stem just before a 'qu' sound (Tar|quin, Al|gonquin, collo|quial, elo|quent, a|quin, Marra|kes). Pushes toward 'qu'/'q' tokens.

L27n799.name: Short word-start fragments
L27n799.description: A short word-start fragment such as 'qu', 'd', 'p', 'A', or 'Th' (Mannequ|ins, flower-d|otted, Akh|et, Thelyp|teridaceae). Pushes toward closing quotes, brackets, and markdown '*'.

L27n1340.name: Opening piece, long words
L27n1340.description: A short mid-word piece that opens a long word or name (ts|unami, Sus|ilo, fil|icaleans, sal|amandas, tet|raplegia, Sal|azar). Pushes toward 'param'/'parameter' tokens.

L27n2083.name: Uppercase fragments in caps
L27n2083.description: An uppercase letter run inside an all-caps word, heading, or SQL keyword (GROUP BY, IMM|EDIATE, NORTH CAR|OLINA, WH|OLE, ECHINOC|OCCUS). Pushes toward uppercase fragments like 'CE', 'PE', 'SE'.

L27n2964.name: Mid-word cuts before quotes
L27n2964.description: A mid-word piece near the start of a multi-token word (inf|ested, partic|ulates, cl|ots, euth|anized, fib|rosis, sw|ires). Pushes toward curly quotes and dashes such as '＂', '―', '‐', and '"--'.

L27n2707.name: Word fragments; gold/metal output
L27n2707.description: Fires on a short piece inside a split word or name, such as 'ic' in apricots, 'ec' in Dogecoin, 'et' in whetstone, and 'pot' in potash; pushes toward 'gold' and 'metal'.

L27n1241.name: Word-start fragments; defendant output
L27n1241.description: Fires on the first 1-3 letters of a word split into pieces, often capitalized starts such as 'Se' in Seville, 'Res' in resettlement, and 'sa' in safflower; pushes toward 'defendant' and 'plaintiff'.

L27n272.name: Mid-word pieces; G output
L27n272.description: Fires on a middle or later piece of a multi-token word, such as 'bul' in bulges, 'brid' in unbridled, 'besie' in besieged, and 'OM' in OMG; pushes toward uppercase 'G' tokens like 'GA' and 'GC'.

L27n2925.name: Word-start fragments; guess output
L27n2925.description: Fires on the short opening piece of a word split into tokens, often a capitalized name such as 'Le' in Leibniz, 'Pl' in Plague, or 'Ps' in Psophodes; pushes toward 'guess' and 'unknown'.

L27n2947.name: Word-initial letter F
L27n2947.description: Fires on a capital or lowercase 'F' (or 'ph') that opens a word or fragment, such as 'F' in Fossil, Ferrets, Ferry, and Faisal, or 'ph' in phagocytes; pushes toward 'filter'.

L27n2276.name: Mixed fragments; visit output
L27n2276.description: Fires on short fragments inside words or names, such as '-r' in rhizobium, 'oph' in sarcophagus, 'b' in Middlesbrough, and 'Ex' in Exile; pushes toward 'visit' and 'visitor'.

L27n2132.name: c onsets; cl output
L27n2132.description: Fires on a 'c' or an 'ac'/'enc' that opens a word fragment, such as 'enc' in encroached and enclosures, 'Ac' in Acadian, and '-c' in crust; pushes toward 'cl' tokens.

L27n2250.name: Word-start fragments; quote-closer output
L27n2250.description: Fires on short opening fragments like 'sc', 'sh', 'hyp', and 'Tr' (e.g. 'sc' in scoliosis, 'hyp' in hypodermis), and on the newline right after a chat turn's end token; pushes toward ')' and quote-closing punctuation.

L27n784.name: Proper-name fragments; surnames
L27n784.description: Fires on a middle or second piece of a capitalized place or person name split into tokens, such as 't' in Gettysburg, 'm' in Ormara, 'Jo' in Joaquin, and 'Ash' in Ash'ari; pushes toward common surnames like Smith, Jones, and Miller.

L27n2401.name: Word-start fragments; union output
L27n2401.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, often 'f' or 'Fr' starts such as 'f' in feta and fritters, or 'infl' in inflamed; pushes toward 'union', 'intersection', and 'merge'.

L27n1279.name: Creative-writing prompts; artist/music output
L27n1279.description: Fires on 'Write', 'a', and 'with' in creative-writing or song requests, and on opening quotes around artwork, song, or poem titles such as the '“' before Water Lilies; pushes toward 'artist' and 'music'.

L27n1561.name: Tr/Par/Sk fragments; automatic output
L27n1561.description: Fires on the first two letters of a split word or name, especially 'Tr', 'Par', 'Sk', and 'Ar' such as 'Sk' in Skopje, 'Par' in Paraguay, and 'Tr' in trivially; pushes toward 'automatic' and 'automate'.

L27n2424.name: Prefix fragments; record output
L27n2424.description: Fires on a word-opening fragment that the next token continues, such as 'cultiv' in cultivars, 'contr' in contrived, 'def' in defecate, and 'Vas' in Vasari; pushes toward 'record' and 'records'.

L27n286.name: Word fragments; comma output
L27n286.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word or name, such as 'Tik' in Tikki, 'Qu' in quinoa, 'Sur' in surprised, and 'Neg' in neglected; pushes toward a following comma.

L27n2011.name: g/sw starts; tag output
L27n2011.description: Fires on short fragments that open a longer word, such as 'las' in lasagna, 'synt' in syntactic, 'sw' in swimmers, and 'g' in God-given; pushes toward 'tag' and 'tags'.

L27n2883.name: Mid-name fragments; reward output
L27n2883.description: Fires on a second or later piece of a proper name split into tokens, such as 'akh' in Nakhon, 'Kr' in Krabi, 'ap' in Haʻapai, and 'Bag' in Bagh; pushes toward 'reward' and 'award'.

L27n361.name: Name fragments; punctuation output
L27n361.description: Fires on a middle piece of a long proper name split into tokens, such as 'uh' in Muhawe, 'T' in Tete, 'Bh' in Bhagabhadra, and 'hr' in Rawilfakhrullin; pushes toward sentence-end punctuation like '.', '!', and '?'.

L27n334.name: Function name before arguments
L27n334.description: Fires on a function or variable name right before an argument list in code or math, such as 'rhs' in rhs(t,y), 'h' in h(x), 'R' in R(t), and 'log' in log(length); pushes toward '(' followed by a noun like '(segment' or '(signal'.

L27n1026.name: Acronym fragments; id output
L27n1026.description: Fires on a fragment inside an acronym or name, such as 'DF' in DFID, 'UN' in UNDP, and 'M' in MIF, and on mid-word pieces like 'ta' in curtailed; pushes toward 'id' and 'ID'.

L27n899.name: Capital-R starts; ampersand output
L27n899.description: Fires on a capital 'R' (or lowercase 'r') that opens a term or list item, especially 'R&D', 'Rickets', 'Routines', and 'Rational'; pushes toward '&'.
L27n899.name_orig: Capital R word starts; ampersand output

L27n897.name: Split-name middle fragments
L27n897.description: Fires on a middle subword piece of a proper name or loanword split across tokens, such as 'fon' in Alfonso, 'elf' in Filadelfia, 'SS' in CCSO, or 'ce' in Starcevo; the pole promotes 'io'/'bio' and steered output spams 'io'.

L27n1028.name: Health text, profession nouns
L27n1028.description: Fires on word fragments and mid-phrase words in health and science text, such as 'intr' in intravenous, 'chronic', 'with' in covered with, or 'financial'; the pole promotes profession nouns like 'logger', 'scientist', 'doctor', and steered output repeats them.

L27n767.name: Mid-word fragments, 'al' suffix
L27n767.description: Fires on a word-internal fragment that is not a whole word, such as 'exh' in exhale, 'neut' in neuter, 'ceph' in microcephaly, or 'ost' in nostalgia; the pole promotes 'al'/'AL' tokens and steered output spams 'al'.

L27n1436.name: Interaction and interface words
L27n1436.description: Fires on tokens inside technical and user-interaction phrases, such as 'mouse' and 'finger' in clicks and movement, 'user' in user-friendly, or 'Non' in Nonproliferation; the pole promotes 'inter' tokens (interaction, interface) and steered output spams 'Inter'.

L27n2130.name: 'mis' and word-start fragments
L27n2130.description: Fires on 'mis' word starts and other word-start fragments of names and words, such as 'mis' in misfits, mischance, or mishapen, 'Par' in Parakeet, and 'Ray' in Ray Hubbard; the pole promotes 'ident'/'identity' and steered output spams 'Ident identity'.

L27n1800.name: Capitalized-name first pieces
L27n1800.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name or place split across tokens, such as 'Beth|any', 'Rom|mel', 'N|akhon', 'Hol|man', or 'Her|lyne'; the pole promotes 'update'/'updates' and steered output repeats 'update'.

L27n829.name: Numbers and value nouns
L27n829.description: Fires on numbers and measure or quantity words, such as the '8' in 8611 meters, 'orig' in origination fees, 'syll' in syllables, or the '3' in 300 degrees; the pole promotes 'values', 'numbers', and 'prices', and steered output repeats 'values' or 'prices'.

L27n1883.name: Word-initial M
L27n1883.description: Fires on a word-initial 'm' or 'M' piece that starts a word or name, such as 'M' in Mennonite, 'm' in mares, mugs, and mowers, or 'Mon' in Monet; the pole promotes 'Ma'/'ma' and steered output repeats 'Ma'.

L27n1385.name: Short syllables before 'op'
L27n1385.description: Fires on short word-start syllables that sit before an 'op' sound, such as 'sto' in stoop, 'es' in Aesop, 'Slo' in sloping, or 'countert' in countertop; the pole promotes 'op' and steered output spams 'Op'.

L27n2171.name: Word-initial R
L27n2171.description: Fires on word-initial 'r' or 'R' pieces, such as 'R' in rake angle, 'r' in ranger, rationally, or rate, and 'Re' in Rethink, plus '-int' in low-intensity; the pole promotes 'rate'/'rates' and steered output spams 'Rate'.

L27n1884.name: Word-initial P
L27n1884.description: Fires on word-initial 'p' or 'P' pieces, such as 'P' in Puffling, Pteridomaniacs, Polar bear, or Penguin, plus 'op' in Neoplatonic; the pole promotes 'population' and 'pop', and steered output spams 'Pop'.

L27n444.name: Latin name middle fragments
L27n444.description: Fires on middle pieces of long Latin, scientific, or foreign names, especially inside parentheses or quotes, such as 'ry' in Phrynosoma, 'ely' in Thelypteridaceae, or 'perm' in Cardiospermum; the pole promotes closing-quote and closing-paren tokens and steered output spams quote marks.

L27n1048.name: IPA and rare-script symbols
L27n1048.description: Fires on IPA phonetic symbols such as ə, ɪ, ˈ, and ʲ, plus non-Latin script characters like Devanagari and Thai; the pole promotes HTML character entities such as '&#', '&nbsp', and '&amp', and steered output spams '&nbsp' or '&#'.

L27n1277.name: Name/list-item word starts
L27n1277.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name or a list-item word, such as 'Gle' in Gleicheniaceae, 'Sel' in Selaginellaceae, 'Gu' in Guimarães, 'f' in fables or feta, and 'Br' in Brunsbüttel; the pole promotes closing brackets and closing quotes, and steered output spams them.

L27n2723.name: 'Bel'/'L' word starts
L27n2723.description: Fires on word starts 'Bel', 'Bl', 'L', and 'l', such as 'Bel' in Beloved or Belgrave, 'Bl' in Blanche, 'L' in Lauterpacht, or 'l' in lizards; the pole promotes 'adjacent', 'neighbor', and 'nearby', and steered output repeats them.

L27n1204.name: Proper-name first pieces
L27n1204.description: Fires on the first piece of a proper name or capitalized word, such as 'Az' in azaleas, 'De' in De Gaulle or Dindl, 'Pont' in Pontifical, or 'Mel' in Melvin; the pole promotes 'gr'/'Gr'/'grid' and steered output spams 'Gr'.

L27n1816.name: Acronym/technical-term starts
L27n1816.description: Fires on the first piece of acronyms and technical terms, such as 'P' in PESCO or PDD-NOS, 'V' in VSDs or Vortex, 'h' in hatching or hilly, and 'contr' in contraption; the pole promotes 'component' and steered output repeats 'Component'.

L27n1538.name: Virus and vector context
L27n1538.description: Fires on 'v' starts of virus and vaccine words, such as retro-v-irus, v-accine offered, or antiretro-v-iral, and in disease-transmission text (contagious, transmitted, parasite, bacteria); the pole promotes 'vector' and 'vec', and steered output spams 'Vector'.

L27n2342.name: Proper-name first pieces, places
L27n2342.description: Fires on the first piece of a proper name or place split across tokens, such as 'Khal' in Khalifa, 'Cal' in Calle Joaquin, 'Bal' in Balochistan, 'Se' in Seville, or 'Lal' in Laliberté; the pole promotes 'drop'/'drops'/'dropped' and steered output spams 'drop'.

L27n2259.name: Stems before a suffix
L27n2259.description: Fires on a word stem split before its suffix, such as 'thr' in thrived or thrusters, 'pract' in practising, 'Comp' in compounds, 'suff' in suffused, or 'discrim' in discriminated; the pole promotes 'len' and '(len' tokens, and steered output spams 'len'.

L27n826.name: Word-start pieces: customer
L27n826.description: The leading piece of a proper noun or word split into subword tokens (Or|kney, str|onsay, Os|mond, Sil|ent), peaking on the piece before the rest of the word; pushes the model toward 'customer' and 'patient'.

L27n1952.name: Split-word start: address
L27n1952.description: The first piece of a word split across tokens, mostly 'wh', 'sk', 'fl', 'sw', 'sl' (whetstone, skit, flaking, swaddle), peaking on that opening piece; pushes the model toward 'address' tokens.

L27n529.name: Business and finance context
L27n529.description: Weak, spread across business, finance and corporate text (interest rates, company proposals, SWOT analysis, incorporating); peaks on '%' after an interest rate and on 'inc' in 'incorporating'; pushes the model toward 'customer' and 'market'.

L27n1688.name: 'wh' word-start pieces: item
L27n1688.description: Word-start pieces, especially 'wh' (whizzes, whorls, whistling, whiten), plus 'sl', 'Kh' and 'Nad' in names; pushes the model toward 'item' and 'items'.

L27n197.name: Inside author-year citations
L27n197.description: Commas and '&' inside author-year citations such as '(Marcus, Forsyth, Stone ... & Blair 2000)', peaking on the comma after a name; pushes the model to write closing ')' tokens.

L27n1346.name: Search and index lookup
L27n1346.description: The word before a noun in search, index, hash and join text ('search' in search engine or search list, 'hash' in hash function, 'two' in joining two tables); pushes the model toward 'index' tokens.

L27n715.name: Agency and institution names
L27n715.description: The head word of official agency or institution names (National, Army, Drug, Veterans, Wildlife, Military), peaking mid-name; pushes the model toward code type names 'String' and 'Object'.

L27n695.name: Capital letters starting names
L27n695.description: A lone capital letter or abbreviation that starts a proper name (M in Macclesfield, U in Uppsala, N in Nave, M.D.); in steered text it pushes sentence-end punctuation and newlines.

L27n641.name: Foreign-name fragments: á
L27n641.description: Pieces of split Spanish, Hungarian and French proper names (Cer|da, Man|uel, Sán|dor, Guimar|ães); pushes the model toward accented vowels á and í.

L27n3027.name: Word piece before 'um'
L27n3027.description: Partial words that stop mid-word, such as 'exh' in exhales, 'gh' in sorghum, 'rhe' in rheumatic and 'perf' in perfumes; pushes the model toward 'um' pieces.

L27n2919.name: Word piece before 'ig'
L27n2919.description: The piece right before an 'ig' syllable (inst|igated, Vit|iligo, em|igrated, Rel|igion); pushes the model toward 'ig' pieces, so steered output becomes 'igigig'.

L27n1671.name: Consonant-cluster word starts
L27n1671.description: Word-initial consonant clusters split off from the rest of the word (cr|umble, Fl|ank, bl|anch, contr|ived, f|eta); pushes the model toward 'expected' and 'expect'.

L27n1249.name: Name-piece fragments: def
L27n1249.description: Middle pieces of split proper names (Hot|am|isligil, Mos|he, Dor|set, En|cke), peaking on the piece inside the name; pushes the model toward 'def' and 'Def' tokens.

L27n2218.name: Mid-word fragments: port
L27n2218.description: Mid-word and word-start pieces (imp|urities, p|teridomaniacs, Pur|ana, op|reservation, CORR|ESPONDENCE); pushes the model toward 'port' tokens.

L27n2995.name: Word-start fragments: sem
L27n2995.description: Word-start pieces such as 'res' (resonant), 'nons' (nonspecific), 'Rem' (Remembrance), 'spr' (sprouts), and 'is' in 'semisolid'; pushes the model toward 'sem' tokens.

L27n1486.name: Mid-word pieces: animal
L27n1486.description: Word-start or mid-word pieces, often inside place or person names (Ser|engeti, Hash|em, Pen|ryn, Kut|cher, Sw|indon); pushes the model toward 'animal' and 'cursor'.

L27n2283.name: Capital letter: icon
L27n2283.description: Capital first letters that start names and acronyms (E in Euphrates, Elias, Euthanasia; Ma in Maasai; Ja in Jaén), plus 'ro' in roamed; pushes the model toward 'icon' and '.png'.

L27n2541.name: w-start pieces: win
L27n2541.description: The 'w' or 'sw' start of a split word, especially before 'in' (sw|immers, /w|inning, W|IRE, Sw|indon); pushes the model toward 'win' tokens.

L27n2650.name: Consonant starts: contribution
L27n2650.description: Consonant-cluster starts of split words (Br|igid, Kr|ill, contr|arious, Con|quering, Ne|ighboring); pushes the model toward 'contribution' and 'contribute' tokens.

L27n2681.name: Bare capital N
L27n2681.description: A bare capital N that starts an acronym or word (NHTSA, Nausea, Nurses, NIE, Nimetz, NORTH); pushes the model toward 'fire' tokens.

L27n709.name: Mid-word fragment, writes 'a'
L27n709.description: Fires on the second or later piece of a word split into subword tokens (ox|az|olidinones, death|kn|ell) and on the newline that closes a chat user turn. Pushes the model toward a bare 'a' suffix token, so output degenerates into 'aa(aa('.

L27n1357.name: Compound 'c', writes 'col'
L27n1357.description: Fires on a 'c' or 'oc' piece inside a science or medical compound (Anti-c|ancer, radi-oc|arbon, meningo-c|occal) and on 'photoc' or 'hem' pieces. Pushes toward 'col' tokens, so steered output is 'col col col'.

L27n2495.name: Proper-name fragment, writes 'Islamic'
L27n2495.description: Fires on the first or second piece of a proper name or title, e.g. 'T' in Tisha B'Av, 'Ol' in Olives, 'Bl' in Blasco, 'ham' in Ramkhamhaeng. Pushes toward 'Islamic' and 'Muslim' tokens, so steered output spams 'Muslim'.

L27n2195.name: World 'War', writes 'crime'
L27n2195.description: Fires most strongly on 'War' in 'World War II' and on violence-related word stems (Nazi, -ocide, minstrel). Pushes toward 'crime' and 'criminal' tokens, yet steered output is a carriage-return spam.

L27n525.name: Hyphen-split piece, writes 're'
L27n525.description: Fires on a word piece right after a hyphen or inside a place name, most strongly 'iddles' in Middlesbrough and 'un' after a prefix. Pushes toward 're' word-ending tokens, so steered output is 'rerere'.

L27n1662.name: 'c|ell' piece, writes 'cell'
L27n1662.description: Fires on a 'c' or 'ex' fragment that opens a word piece before 'ell' or 'ysts' endings (single-c|elled, nemat-oc|ysts, photoc|atalytic). Pushes toward 'cell' and 'cells' tokens, so steered output is 'Cell cells cell'.

L27n2899.name: Lone 'g'/'h', writes 'balance'
L27n2899.description: Fires on a lone 'g', 'G', 'h' or 'og' piece mid-word or after a hyphen (amin-og-lycoside, self-h-arming, Ag-artala). Pushes toward 'balance' tokens, so steered output is 'Bal balanced balance'.

L27n2071.name: Lone 'b', writes 'bin'
L27n2071.description: Fires on a lone 'b' or 'B' piece that starts a second word part (fire-b|ombing, Middles-b|rough, eye-b|row, Bab|ylon). Pushes toward 'bin' and 'binary' tokens, so steered output is 'bin bin bin'.

L27n475.name: G/g starts, writes rules
L27n475.description: Fires on a capital or lowercase 'G', 'g' or 'R' that starts a name or word piece (G-d, G-ospels, G-arter, g-loomy, R-ama). Pushes toward underscore and dash separator tokens, so steered output is '--- ***' rules.
L27n475.name_orig: Capital G or g start, writes rules

L27n1407.name: Mid-name piece, writes '-ing'
L27n1407.description: Fires on a piece of a multi-token name or word just before its end, e.g. 'Z' and 'UL' in Zulu, 'Ever' in Everest, 'Scott' in Coretta Scott King. Pushes toward 'ing' and 'ING' endings, so steered output is 'Inging'.

L27n536.name: Organisation/place name start
L27n536.description: Fires on the first token of an organisation, place or group name, e.g. 'UN' in UNICEF, 'Tel' in Tel Aviv, 'Ret' in Retriever, 'CDC', 'HIV' in HIV sufferers. Pushes toward country names (China, India, Italy), so steered output is 'India India'.

L27n2138.name: Word-opening 'sc/st/str' piece
L27n2138.description: Fires on a word-opening consonant cluster split off from its word, e.g. 'sc' in scoliosis, 'Stan' in Stanwick, 'str' in Stronsay, 'sn' in snags. Pushes toward 'collect' and 'collection' tokens, so steered output is 'Collect collection'.

L27n1200.name: Post-hyphen 'c', writes 'files'
L27n1200.description: Fires on a 'c' or 'C' right after a hyphen or prefix (non-c|ancerous, post-C|OVID, post-c|ivil, terra-c|otta) and on 'Sh' in Shunga. Pushes toward 'files' and 'Files' tokens, so steered output is 'files files'.

L27n254.name: Diacritic and IPA letters
L27n254.description: Fires on non-English letters inside Latin-script words: IPA symbols (ˈ, ə, ɪ), transliteration marks (ṭ, ś, ḥ, ʾ, ā) and Polish or Czech accents (ę, č). Pushes toward accented European endings (äre, è, é, ă), so steered output is 'éé áéé'.

L27n1609.name: Name-internal piece, writes 'strong'
L27n1609.description: Fires on a piece inside a multi-token name or number, e.g. 'can' in Perna canaliculus, 'lem' in Charlemagne, 'aim' in Maimonides, the '0' in 163,000. Pushes toward 'strong' and 'strength' tokens, so steered output is 'Strong strong strong'.

L27n2198.name: Proper-name start, writes 'sent'
L27n2198.description: Fires on the first token of a proper name, e.g. 'Cl' in Clifton, 'Santa' in Santa Rosa, 'Ch' in Chaco, 'Sw' in Swastika Forest. Pushes toward 'sent' and 'send' tokens, so steered output is 'Sent sent sent'.

L27n2569.name: Mid-name fragment, writes 'scenario'
L27n2569.description: Fires on a word or name piece that opens mid-token, e.g. 'ab' in Athabasca, 'exh' in exhorted, 'inde' in indestructible, 'aling' in Stalingrad. Pushes toward 'scenario', 'situation' and 'scene' tokens.

L27n2498.name: Word-start fragment, writes 'clothing'
L27n2498.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split across tokens, e.g. 'tre' in treacherous, 'H' in Hittite, 'hon' in honours, 'stre' in streusel, '-h' in self-harming. Pushes toward 'wear' and 'clothing' tokens, so steered output is 'clothing clothing'.

L27n1910.name: 'str' start, writes 'area'
L27n1910.description: Fires on the 'str' piece that opens a word (straits, Stronsay, strung, strangle) and on 'atro' in paratroops. Pushes toward 'area' tokens, so steered output is 'Area area area'.

L27n2604.name: Post-hyphen piece, writes 'sk'
L27n2604.description: Fires on the piece that follows a hyphen or prefix (dis-abled, beta-car-otene, anti-s-hear, E-s-chool) and on 'uns' in unsuited. Pushes toward 'sk' and 'Sk' tokens, so steered output is 'Sk sk sk'.

L27n594.name: IPA symbols, Greek-letter writer
L27n594.description: Fires on IPA and pronunciation symbols (ɪ, ˈ, ə) and romanized foreign-word pieces inside brackets or transliterations; pushes the next token toward Greek letters like alpha, lambda and gamma.

L27n993.name: Mid-word fragments to error
L27n993.description: Negative on the middle piece of a word split across tokens, mostly in rare names and words (Sus|ilo, kr|ainian, loss|aceae); pushes toward 'error' and 'Error' tokens.

L27n2808.name: Subword ant to po
L27n2808.description: Negative on subword pieces such as 'ant' (antiseptic, antitrust, antiretroviral) and 'op' that start a split word; pushes toward 'po' and 'poem' tokens.

L27n1224.name: Unicode symbols and mojibake
L27n1224.description: Fires on unusual Unicode symbols inside plain text: superscript digits (¹⁴C), fractions (⅔), mojibake like Â and Ç, and marks like °; pushes toward §, ¶, «, » and °C.

L27n2274.name: Name-start piece to database
L27n2274.description: Fires on the opening piece of a split proper noun or word (Sh|ed, Gutz|on, Ele|phants, .de|zeen); pushes toward 'database' and 'Database' tokens, with a weak steering effect.

L27n526.name: Opening paren before restatement
L27n526.description: Fires on an opening parenthesis right after a number or term that is about to be restated in another unit or form (15.6 °C (60.1 °F), eukaryotes (, DHT (); pushes toward 'me' and 'ming' word pieces.

L27n2059.name: Lone g word-start piece
L27n2059.description: Fires on a lone 'g' or 'g'-initial piece that starts a split word or hyphenated compound (poly|g|amy, migr|aines, fully-|g|rown); pushes toward 'gl' and 'Gl' tokens.

L27n1424.name: Manner adverb to method
L27n1424.description: Fires on the word right after a manner adverb in instructions (gently but, slowly and, quietly and, done correctly); pushes toward 'method' and 'methods' tokens.

L27n233.name: Name starts, writes '?'
L27n233.description: Diffuse negative pole, strongest on the first letter of a proper name or word fragment (H|ibernian, F|aisal, A|loo); pushes toward question marks '？' and '?'.

L27n1658.name: Name starts, writes escapes
L27n1658.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name or term (Th|ompson, Ga|uguin, Kö|ppen, Can|aan); pushes toward HTML entities, escaped quotes and mojibake such as &eacute and �s.

L27n1812.name: Ch word-start to integer
L27n1812.description: Fires on the opening 'Ch' or 'ch' piece of a word or heading (Ch|ronic, Ch|olesterol, Ch|ores), strongest at line starts; pushes toward 'integer' and 'Integer' tokens.

L27n1303.name: 'po' piece, group-noun writer
L27n1303.description: Fires on the 'po' piece that starts a split word (po|achers, po|aching, Po|ems); pushes toward group nouns like teams, businesses, communities and companies.

L27n1621.name: Name pieces to context
L27n1621.description: Negative on the first letter or piece of a rare name or scientific term (L|avinia, L|orraine, heter|osporous, cl|enching); pushes toward 'context' and 'ctx' tokens.

L27n1601.name: Name pieces to handle
L27n1601.description: Negative on a mid-word piece inside a rare name or taxon (Psoph|odes, Hymen|ophyllaceae, Ap|ollinaris, La|Hood); pushes toward 'handle' and 'handling' tokens.

L27n2279.name: Mid-word t to task
L27n2279.description: Fires on a short fragment inside a split word, often a lone 't' (twin|t|urreted, Con|ception, Ath|abasca); pushes toward 'task' and 'tasks' tokens.

L27n2103.name: Lone s/f, writes race
L27n2103.description: Negative on a lone 's' or 'f' that starts a word or hyphen piece (s|cones, f|eta, f|rogs, s|ugar); pushes toward 'race' and 'races' tokens.
L27n2103.name_orig: Lone s or f to race

L27n1623.name: Syllable starts to char
L27n1623.description: Negative on the first syllable of a word split into pieces (mel|on, Squ|ares, pl|ow, Mah|arudhra); pushes toward 'char' and 'characters' tokens.

L27n1039.name: Word before object
L27n1039.description: Negative on the word just before 'object(s)' in phrases like 'digital object identifiers' and 'large objects'; weaker on other word starts; pushes toward 'object' tokens.

L27n898.name: Sh/Sc/Sm starts, exclamation writer
L27n898.description: Fires on the opening 'Sh', 'Sc', 'Sm' or 'sh' piece of a word or name (Sh|alimar, Sc|issorhands, Sm|og, sh|aking); pushes toward exclamation marks '!' and '！'.
L27n898.name_orig: Sh Sc Sm starts to exclamation

L27n1146.name: Word-start pieces to True
L27n1146.description: Negative on the opening piece of a split word or name (squ|irts, Sw|edes, yol|ks, Pal|umbo); pushes toward boolean literals True, False and None.

L27n1302.name: Mid-word subword fragments
L27n1302.description: Fires (goes negative) on a short piece of a word split across tokens, e.g. 'ish' in 'tr-ish-atorrey', 'ant' in 'anti-trust', 'mac' in 'macaws'; pushed negative, it writes uppercase 'ST/AT' fragments.

L27n918.name: Rare-word mid-pieces
L27n918.description: Fires on a later piece of a long or rare word split into tokens, e.g. 'ac' in halicacabum, 'ic' in penicillins, 'orp' in scorpions; pushes the model toward word-start 'inf/Inf/inv/inc' fragments.

L27n3031.name: Word-start Se/Sp fragments
L27n3031.description: Fires on the first piece of words starting 'Se' or 'Sp' that are split into tokens (se in sepsis/seborrhea, Sp in Spence/Spicy/Spelling); pushes toward 'expand/expansion' tokens, which do not match the read.

L27n782.name: Capitalized name-start fragments
L27n782.description: Fires on the capitalized first piece of a split proper noun or title (Po in Poop to Power, Y in Yuen, Bo in Boise, V in Vashon, B in Bering); pushes toward bare single capital letters like A, E, C, S.

L27n1183.name: Science-term mid-word pieces
L27n1183.description: Fires on a middle piece of a long scientific or Latin term split into tokens (ut in Neutrophils, ios in angiosperms, ym in Gymnospermae, at in phosphatases); pushes toward 'ph' fragments (ph, Ph, PH) as in phosphate.

L27n1862.name: Word-start P/p fragments
L27n1862.description: Fires on a word-initial 'P' or 'p' token, often in split words (P in Polar, Puma, Pomeranian; p in patted, puzzle, pita); pushes toward 'pack/package' tokens.

L27n422.name: Mid-word 'der/m' fragments
L27n422.description: Fires on a middle piece of a long word split into tokens, most often der/ider in dermis and epidermis and nos in gymnosperms; pushes toward bare 'm' fragments (m, ms, mo, mi), which the model then repeats as 'Mmmm'.

L27n3004.name: Name-start 'ch/Ph' fragments
L27n3004.description: Fires on a short word-start fragment inside a capitalized name or split word (ch in chisel/chowders, Ph in Phatthalung, Cor in Coral, Sh in Shiloh, Jer in Jerk); pushes toward 'connection' tokens.

L27n1262.name: Technical word fragments, 'food'
L27n1262.description: Diffuse: fires on pieces of technical words (Gradient in Extreme Gradient boosting, nond in nondiscriminatory, intr in intravascular) and on 'food' in resource lists; pushes toward 'des/Des' tokens.

L27n2133.name: Proper-name fragments, 'format'
L27n2133.description: Fires (goes negative) on a piece of a surname or proper noun split into tokens (ö in Pöyry, agem in Hagemann, lem in Charlemagne, Daw in Dawes Gap); pushed negative, it writes 'format/Format' tokens.

L27n1625.name: Piece before 'v' fragment
L27n1625.description: Fires on the piece just before a continuation that starts with 'v' inside a split word (chie before vous, retrie before vers, lar before val, bre before vit); pushes toward word-start 'v' tokens like var, val, via.

L27n1243.name: Wetland/marsh words
L27n1243.description: Fires (goes negative) mainly on 'wet' in wetlands and 'marsh' in marshlands, plus scattered word pieces (th in hawthorn, N in Nauvoo, m in mignon); pushed negative, it writes 'me/Me' tokens.

L27n2295.name: Early word-piece fragments
L27n2295.description: Fires on the early piece of a longer word split into tokens (oc in radiocarbon and dioceses, arch in archetypal, con in confluence, cam in camotes, orb in orbiter); pushes toward 'cons/consistent' tokens.

L27n2469.name: Lone-letter word-start fragments
L27n2469.description: Fires (goes negative) on the short first piece of a word split across tokens, often a lone consonant or syllable (w in wondrous/wiser/waned, c in ceded, per in periphery, fer in ferocious); pushed negative, it writes 'coin/money' tokens.

L27n576.name: Language/people name pieces
L27n576.description: Fires (goes negative) on a piece of a language, people, or culture name split into tokens (Beng in Benga, Ibn, Jing/Ling/Ming in Chinese names); pushed negative, it writes 'ak' fragments and language names like Japanese, Korean, Indonesian.

L27n822.name: Early word-piece fragments
L27n822.description: Fires on early pieces of multi-token words (co in coexist, st in staves, pre in pre-exposure, cont in contortionists, G in Ghetto) with no single clear theme; pushes toward 'ex/Ex' tokens.

L27n1251.name: 'check' context words
L27n1251.description: Fires (goes negative) on words that set up 'check', such as spell in spell checker, Fact in fact-checking, and plagiarism, plus 'in' after get/stay/keep; pushed negative, it writes 'check/checks/checking'.

L27n1904.name: Opening fragments 'Th/Sh/Dar'
L27n1904.description: Fires (goes negative) on the opening fragment of a capitalized or technical word split into tokens (Th in Thespians and Thelypteridaceae, Sh in Shaheen, Dar in Dar es Salaam, rh in rhizomes); pushed negative, it writes 'player/Player' tokens.

L27n3026.name: Consonant-cluster word starts
L27n3026.description: Fires on a word-initial consonant cluster split off from its word (bl in blurring, str in straddles, Cl in Clifton, kr in krill, bre in brevitomentosus); pushes toward 'stop/stops' tokens.

L27n458.name: Open parenthesis before acronyms
L27n458.description: Fires (goes negative) on the '(' that opens an acronym or abbreviation, e.g. '(SCI)', '(AIDS)', '(MDA)', '(DIC)', '(HIV)'; pushed negative, it writes capital 'S' fragments like SX, SB, SR.

L27n982.name: Predicts number words
L27n982.description: Fires on short label tokens that open a list item or field, such as a lone 'G' or 'g', '|', ':', an opening quote or '-', mostly in web text and tables. Pushes the next token toward number words (One, Three, Four).

L27n1161.name: Name fragment to extension
L27n1161.description: Strongly negative on a later piece of a name or word split into subtokens, such as 'Ik' in Ikhtiyar, 'Ker' in Keret, 'Pl' in Plasma or 'Share' in Share-Alike. Pushes toward 'ext' and 'extension' tokens.

L27n457.name: Compound middle, writes week
L27n457.description: Strongly negative on the middle piece of a split compound, hyphenated name or acronym, such as '-' in Merriam-Webster, 'GV' in GVWR, 'ON' in BRONCO or 'cross' in crossfire. Pushes toward 'week' and 'w' tokens.

L27n2197.name: Mid-word piece to upper
L27n2197.description: Strongly negative on a middle subword of a long word split into pieces, such as 'unw' in unworthy, 'vir' in retrovirus, 'in' in rhinotracheitis or 'ile' in Marsileaceae. Pushes toward 'upper' and 'upload'.

L27n1701.name: Second-half 'b', writes bit
L27n1701.description: Fires on a lone 'b' or '-b' that opens the second half of a split or hyphenated word, such as 'nuts-bolts', 'qu-bits', 'bittersweet' or 'basking'. Pushes toward 'bit' and 'bits'.

L27n2222.name: Chat turn-end newline
L27n2222.description: Fires on the newline that closes a user turn just before '<|im_start|>assistant' in chat-formatted text, and on '√' in math. Pushes toward ellipsis '..' tokens.

L27n685.name: Noun prefix, writes projects
L27n685.description: Fires on the first piece of a split noun or adjective, such as 'micro' in microfinance or microaggression, 'lyr' in lyrical, 'ad' in ad copy or 'show' in show notes. Pushes toward 'projects' and 'apps' tokens.

L27n1702.name: Word-start G to event
L27n1702.description: Strongly negative on a capital or lowercase 'G' or 'g' that starts a word or name (Gutzon, Glooskap, GDP, gauze, gobbled), and on 'sc' in scarring. Pushes toward 'event' and 'events'.

L27n2981.name: 'sw' start, writes foot
L27n2981.description: Fires on the first piece of words starting 'sw' (swamps, swishing, swimmers, swelling) and on similar openers such as 'j' in jicama. Pushes toward 'foot', 'feet' and 'leg'.

L27n2534.name: Word opener to fuel
L27n2534.description: Fires on the opening piece of a multi-token word, such as 'agr' in agritech, 'cro' in crocodiles, 'str' in straits, 'gl' in glaucoma or 'oc' in diocese. Pushes toward 'fuel', 'carbon' and 'combustion'.

L27n479.name: Word opener to prepositions
L27n479.description: Fires on an early piece of a split word, such as 'lo' in loaves, 'shr' in shrubs, 'enc' in encased or 'mil' in milpa. Pushes toward the prepositions For, By, To, On and Of.

L27n1216.name: Head noun to run
L27n1216.description: Strongly negative on a head noun that often forms a compound, such as 'run' in run scorer or bank run, 'show' in show notes, or 'ground' and 'ad'. Pushes toward 'run' and 'running'.

L27n38.name: Name piece to is
L27n38.description: Strongly negative on an early or middle piece of a proper name split into tokens, such as 'uh' in Mwawe, 'Hash' in Hashem, 'Cre' in Cremonesi or 'Ik' in Ikhtiyar. Pushes toward short tokens 'is', 'at', 'am' and 'h'.

L27n403.name: Word start to cells
L27n403.description: Fires on the first subword of a longer term or name, such as 'Sh' in Shiloh or Shalimar, 'Fort' in Fort Detrick, 'lent' in lentil or 'fo' in focal. Pushes toward 'cells', 'cars' and 'children'.

L27n1822.name: Ex/Con prefix, writes express
L27n1822.description: Fires on a prefix-like first piece of a split word, such as 'Ex' in endogenous, 'Con' in Conduct or Consenting, 'Gen' in Genbaku, or 'Dev' in Devi. Pushes toward 'express' and 'expression'.

L27n986.name: Mid-word piece to quote
L27n986.description: Strongly negative on a mid-word piece inside a split name or word, such as 'Eck' in Eckstrom, 'sw' in swishing, 'An' in Anjana or 'ol' in scoliosis. Pushes toward closing quote and bracket tokens.

L27n1085.name: Mid-word piece to se
L27n1085.description: Strongly negative on a piece that continues a word split into tokens, such as 'cur' in curiosities, 'op' in cephalopod, 'poly' in polyglots, 'os' in osseointegration or 'ge' in geology. Pushes toward 'se' and 'Se'.

L27n1967.name: Word-start H to hold
L27n1967.description: Strongly negative on a lone 'H' or 'h' that starts a word, often after a hyphen or at a sentence start (Hindus, Habitat, HIDE, self-harm, hiding). Pushes toward 'hold' and 'held'.

L27n2969.name: Early piece, writes impact
L27n2969.description: Strongly negative on a short early piece of a split word or name, such as 'E' in Euphrates, 're' in reconnection, 'gre' in greening, 'em' in emperor or 'Cass' in Cassini. Pushes toward 'impact' and 'affect'.

L27n2719.name: Word-start fl to empty
L27n2719.description: Strongly negative on 'fl' starting a word or name (flinch, flares, flax, flammable, Flintridge). Pushes toward 'empty' and 'blank'.

L27n221.name: Story genre words
L27n221.description: Fires on genre words in creative-writing requests (story, thriller, horror, fantasy, and -packed/-paced modifiers) and on 'be' in 'should be told'; pushes toward damage, injury and disaster words.

L27n2048.name: Fragments; writes British
L27n2048.description: Fires on odd mid-word fragments and capital-led pieces in web text (dise in diseased, -w in moisture-wicking, Copyright, Fem); pushes toward British, England, UK and London.

L27n1013.name: Biomedical pieces; writes elements
L27n1013.description: Fires on a word piece inside a long biomedical or chemistry term (tro in antiretrovirals, ret in retinoblastoma); pushes toward chemical element names such as nitrogen, phosphorus, acid, sulfur and hydrogen.

L27n2033.name: Name-start pieces; writes 'recent'
L27n2033.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalised name or split word (M in Bryn Mawr, Jo in JoVE, bur in burritos); pushes toward 'recent', 'latest' and 'recently'.

L27n2876.name: Mid-word pieces; writes 'appear'
L27n2876.description: Fires on a partial token that opens a longer split word, often a name or noun (Nap|ster, Ch|ame|leons, Mer|ino, thr|ong); pushes toward 'appear' and 'appearance'.

L27n1682.name: Drug/Ph starts; writes Dr
L27n1682.description: Fires on the opening 'Ph' of Thai place names and on 'Drug' or 'pharmac' in mass drug administration text; pushes toward 'Dr' and 'dr' tokens.

L27n1181.name: Compound modifiers; writes ways
L27n1181.description: Fires on the modifier before a compound's head noun (flip|flops, flash|cards, Savings| Accounts, hang|ing, wood|en); pushes toward 'methods', 'ways' and 'approaches'.

L27n1810.name: v-pieces; writes ver
L27n1810.description: Fires on a short opening piece of a split word, mostly 'v' or 'V' (low-voltage, V2 rocket, V-SDs) and 'Non' in nonproliferation; pushes toward 'ver' tokens.

L27n771.name: Word starts; writes Microsoft
L27n771.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, often before a consonant cluster (kr|ill, sw|immers, pr|isms, str|ays, blog); pushes toward 'Microsoft', 'Azure' and 'MS'.

L27n2292.name: Name/word splits; writes 'wave'
L27n2292.description: Fires on a partial token inside a split name or word (Mp|um|alanga, Tomo|Č|ačić, Nan|aimo, Dec|iduous); pushes toward 'wave' and 'waves'.

L27n138.name: Prefixes awaiting a hyphen
L27n138.description: Fires on a prefix or first piece that needs a continuation: 'tele' (telepathically), 'socio' (socio-spatial), and the '-to' in easy-to-follow; pushes toward hyphen-joined suffixes like -in, -time, -line and -step.

L27n792.name: Name/compound starts; writes St
L27n792.description: Fires on the first word of a two-part name or compound (corner|stones, Downing| Street, non|stick, Food| Stamps); pushes toward 'St', 'st' and 'Street'.

L27n881.name: 'ep' starts; writes result
L27n881.description: Fires on the 'ep' piece opening epilepsy, epigenetics and epinephrine, and on other capitalised first pieces (epa.gov, Cerda); pushes toward 'result' tokens.

L27n238.name: Digits inside numbers
L27n238.description: Fires on a single digit in the middle of a multi-digit number (27.2°C, port 520, 1956, 0.92); pushes toward digit tokens 0-9, and steered output degenerates into runs of zeros.

L27n1225.name: 'f' starts, mood nouns
L27n1225.description: Fires on the 'f' opening fantasy, feline or folding, and on mood nouns (suspense, frustration, exhaustion) in writing prompts; pushes toward 'build' and 'building'.

L27n1896.name: Name starts; writes comparatives
L27n1896.description: Fires on the first piece of a proper name or split word (Hor|owitz, Mar|quesas, Cah|ora Bossa); pushes toward size comparatives like larger, smaller, wider and bigger.

L27n2838.name: Split-word starts; writes sun
L27n2838.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, often 'c', 'sh' or 'co' (sh|ampoos, co|conuts, Ac|ropolis, c|ensuses); pushes toward 'solar', 'Sun' and 'sunlight'.

L27n2165.name: Word starts before struct
L27n2165.description: Fires on the opening piece of a split word (inde|structable, sarc|ophagi, extr|acurricular, Pompe|y); pushes toward 'struct', 'structure' and 'structural'.

L27n2499.name: Proper-name starts; writes drug
L27n2499.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalised name split into tokens (Ay|ut|thaya, Bl|asco, Kn|idos, Ch|akma); pushes toward 'drug', 'pharmaceutical' and 'medication'.

L27n1318.name: Prefix pieces; writes mod
L27n1318.description: Fires on the first half of a split prefix word (multim|odal, im|modal, accom|panied, decom|pose); pushes toward 'mod', 'Mod' and 'MOD' tokens.

L27n454.name: Word fragments, turn breaks
L27n454.description: Fires on mid-word subword pieces (e.g. 'Pr' in 'Di|Pr|ima') and on the newline gap right after a user turn ends and the assistant's '<think>' block opens; pushing it negative makes replies terse, with short declarative sentences.

L27n355.name: Ch- name-start fragment
L27n355.description: The 'Ch' piece that opens place and people names split into subwords (Chaco, Chugoku, Chicano, Chaldeans); pushes toward quote and bracket tokens like ' [ {.

L27n1872.name: Word-initial s, writes static
L27n1872.description: Goes negative on a word-initial 's' piece, often right after 'www.' or a space (sciencedaily, sugar, silex, sponged); pushes toward 'static'.

L27n1959.name: Noun before 'plan'
L27n1959.description: The architecture or layout word just before a likely 'plan' ('ground' level, 'Gothic', 'architectural', 'medieval', 'ship'); pushes toward 'plan'/'plans'.

L27n1542.name: Proper-name prefix (Har, Santa)
L27n1542.description: The first piece of a capitalized place or person name split into subwords ('Har' in Harpenden/Harbin, 'Santa' in Santa Rosa, 'ess' in Teesside); pushes toward 'simple'/'simplify'.

L27n1020.name: Consonant-cluster word start
L27n1020.description: Goes negative on the consonant-cluster opening of a word split into pieces, mostly 'cl' (clenching, clots, clippings), 'str' (straits), 'sw' (swishing); pushes toward 'add'/'adding'.

L27n618.name: Mid-word fragment, writes ai
L27n618.description: Goes negative on second-half pieces of multi-token words ('ill', 'ig' in gigawatts, 'contr' in contraptions, 'extr' in extrinsic, 'gir' in giraffe); pushes toward 'ai', 'ary', 'am'.

L27n167.name: Split-word piece, writes p
L27n167.description: Goes negative on pieces of long words split into subwords, especially 'flo' (flip-flops), 'atro' (paratroops), 'stri', 'dri' (dripped); pushes toward the letter 'p' and 'Pp'.

L27n1150.name: Name fragment, writes print
L27n1150.description: Capitalized name fragments ('Cle' in Cleve, 'Ch' in Chaldeans, 'Cl' in Clifton) and, in the averages, the modifier before 'print' ('fine', 'floral', 'thumb', 'cardboard'); pushes toward 'print'/'Print'.

L27n1462.name: Prefix piece, writes array
L27n1462.description: Goes negative on prefix pieces of words split into subwords, especially 'mult' (multilocularis, multicultural), 'micro' (microRNAs), 'agr' (bermudagrass), 'la' (Elaeis); pushes toward 'array'/'arrays'.

L27n2462.name: Name start, writes exist
L27n2462.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a capitalized name or proper noun ('N' in Nostalgia/Nayarit, 'Sen' in Senegal, 'inn' in Mackinac/cinnabar, 'Mag' in Magiolo); pushes toward 'presence'/'exists'.

L27n2916.name: Name/compound start, writes apply
L27n2916.description: Word-start pieces of names and long words ('Ca' in Caernarvon, 'Pr' in PrEP/pruning, 'Mah' in Mahal, 'shr' in shrub, 'ap' in applied); pushes toward 'apply'/'applied'.

L27n303.name: Verb stem before -ing
L27n303.description: The stem piece of a verb split into subwords, just before its -ing or -ed ending ('sne|ezing', 'tens|ing', 'pl|owing', 'attrib|uting'); pushes toward -ing verbs like testing and reading.

L27n1133.name: Word-start piece, writes read
L27n1133.description: Goes negative on word-start fragments of multi-token words, notably 'ste' (steamed, steamer), 'ret' (retelling), 'Edition', and '-th' (ruby-throated); pushes toward 'read'/'reading'.

L27n791.name: Name/word fragment, writes return
L27n791.description: Goes negative on mid-word or name fragments ('bre' in breeder, 'uel' in Guelph, 'tele' in telegraph, 'cam' in camotes, 'Mill' in Millman); pushes toward 'return'/'returns'.

L27n1252.name: Word-start fragment, writes application
L27n1252.description: Fragments that open a longer word or name, e.g. 'Ver' (Verbal), 'Men' (Mennonite), 'Re' (Replacing), 'Pret' (Pretoria), 'Mar' (Marquesas); pushes toward 'application(s)'.

L27n368.name: Word fragment, writes B
L27n368.description: Assorted word-piece fragments, e.g. '-ver' (nonverbal), 'om' (Potomac), 'tert' (tert-butyl), 'CS' (HCSB), 'flash' (flashbacks); pushes toward 'B'/'Bb'.

L27n2397.name: Prefix piece, writes program
L27n2397.description: Prefix pieces that open a word, especially 'rep' (repurpose), 'ref' (refueling), 'Pro'/'pr', 'Matth' (Matthaei), 'immun' (immunisation); pushes toward 'program(s)'.

L27n1543.name: 'cl'/'cons' starts, writes call
L27n1543.description: Goes negative on word-start 'cl' (clonemates, clots, clapping), 'cons' (conscription, consumption) and 'accom' (accompanied); pushes toward 'call'/'calls'.

L27n1038.name: Audience-goal verb, people writer
L27n1038.description: The goal verb or 'your' in marketing phrases just before an audience object ('increase' engagement, 'capture' attention, 'understand' which, 'Target' audience); pushes toward people nouns like user, student, child, customer.

L27n3065.name: Name start, writes di
L27n3065.description: The first piece of a name or split word, e.g. 'Có' (Córdoba), 'Go' (Goebbels), 'Be' (Beccaliu), 'sou' (soups); pushes toward 'di'/'Di'.

L27n1996.name: Split-word onsets, 'extra'
L27n1996.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name or word split into subword tokens (Hash|em, Tit|us, Sp|icy, Stan|wick), pushing the model toward 'extra' and 'additional'.

L27n190.name: Mid-word pieces, 'ovo'
L27n190.description: Negative on the subword piece that splits a longer word (cant|al|oupe, un|cont|rollably, Ha|'ap|ai), pushing toward short '-ovo' and '-olo' fragments.

L27n3022.name: Name's second word, 'network'
L27n3022.description: Negative on the word that follows the first part of an organization or media name (Basel Action Network, Electronic Frontier Foundation, word ladder, TV), pushing toward 'network'.

L27n1629.name: Split names, 'child'
L27n1629.description: Negative on the piece of a surname or place name split into tokens (Roth|amsted, Ker|et, Hos|feld, Rad|chuk), pushing toward 'child' and 'children'.

L27n1341.name: Name-start pieces, '||'
L27n1341.description: Negative on the first piece of a split name or technical term (Fr|isian, Fr|anks, Schw|ann, Verd|igris), pushing toward '||' and '&&' operators.

L27n673.name: Compound-term pieces, 're'
L27n673.description: Negative on the piece that opens a multi-token compound term (retro|viral, neonicotin|oid, mult|ilayer, Prot|olaurasia), pushing toward 're' tokens.

L27n2163.name: Word-start pieces, 'dev'
L27n2163.description: Positive on the first piece of a split name or term (cre|vice, Kh|ulaifi, Buddh|ists, D|harma), pushing toward 'dev' tokens.

L27n1105.name: Name pieces, 'year'
L27n1105.description: Positive on the first piece of a split name or term (Pic|ual, Ston|y, Har|penden), and on 'light' or 'New' before a time phrase, pushing toward 'year' tokens.

L27n2260.name: 'st' word onsets, 'style'
L27n2260.description: Positive on the 'st' onset of a word (st|imulated, st|uffs, st|ressed, St|akeholder, st|abilized), pushing toward 'style' tokens.

L27n2683.name: Word-start pieces, 'demand'
L27n2683.description: Negative on the piece that opens a split word or name (semi|autonomous, Lav|ender, Ikht|iyar, de|Gaulle), pushing toward 'demand' and 'req' tokens.

L27n1648.name: Word onsets, 'raise'
L27n1648.description: Positive on the start of a split word (fl|aring, cam|otes, Cor|imal, Gu|elph, con|duction), pushing toward 'raise' and 'raised'.

L27n2584.name: 'se' onsets, 'curve'
L27n2584.description: Positive on 'se' word onsets (se|borrhea, se|psis, se|pal) and on 'div' (div|inity, div|estment), pushing toward 'curve' tokens.

L27n2555.name: Capital word starts, 'get'
L27n2555.description: Negative on the first piece of a capitalized word or name, especially 'W' and 'Pad' (Padua, Wet Weather, WiringPi), pushing toward 'get' tokens.

L27n217.name: Verb onsets, 'created'
L27n217.description: Positive on the first piece of a verb split into tokens mid-sentence (st|rolled, ref|ueling, spr|ang, ro|amed, f|iddled), pushing toward 'created' and 'formed'.

L27n2716.name: 'cl'/'g' onsets, 'server'
L27n2716.description: Positive on 'cl', 'g', and 'qu' word onsets (cl|ots, cl|otted, g|rafted, qu|illwort, gu|illotine), pushing toward 'server' and 'client' tokens.

L27n1379.name: 'im'/'em' onsets, 'move'
L27n1379.description: Negative on 'im-', 'em-', and 'omn-' word onsets (imm|emorial, im|maculate, em|igrated, omn|ichannel), pushing toward 'move' and 'moving'.

L27n2772.name: Name/term onsets, 'goal'
L27n2772.description: Positive on the first piece of a split name or term (Dol|aucothi, Des|ierto, Fil|adelfia, whe|y), pushing toward 'goal' tokens.

L27n2526.name: 'bl'/'br' onsets, 'smart'
L27n2526.description: Positive on consonant-cluster onsets inside words (bl|anch, bre|aching, ble|aching, sh|aking, p|atty), pushing toward 'smart' and 'intelligent'.

L27n220.name: Punctuation in technical terms
L27n220.description: Negative on hyphens, dashes, and opening parentheses that join or introduce numbers and terms (8-lead, omega-3, (EPA), 3%), pushing toward garbled fragments like 'ascal' and 'erval'.

L27n532.name: Name onsets, comma punctuation
L27n532.description: Positive on the first piece of a capitalized name or term (Dal|mau, Mu|hammad, Be|cciu, D|vur), pushing toward Chinese-style punctuation such as '，' and '：'.

L27n2311.name: Name and title fragments
L27n2311.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a split proper name or title term (Rem in Remembrance, St. in St. Paul, Cath in Cathedrals, Com in Compositions), and on the period after 'St'. Pushes toward the token 'test'; steered, it spams 'Test test'.

L27n283.name: Slot before a number
L27n283.description: Fires on the space or token just before a number in statistics-style text (the space before 2014, 21 million, 5%, 65 years). Pushes toward digit tokens; steered, it spams '1000000' or other digits.

L27n211.name: Leading split-word piece
L27n211.description: Fires on the first sub-token of a word split into pieces, where a further piece must follow (sar|comas, sk|it, der|mis, Sw|immers, assass|ins). Pushes toward 'im' and 'em' pieces; steered, it outputs 'Imimimim' or 'em ememe'.

L27n343.name: Mid-word name fragments
L27n343.description: Negative pole. Fires on a middle sub-token of a proper name or rare word (Mp|um|alanga, Hos|ack, Ban Ki|-m|oon, B|uth|idae, t|urreted). Pushes toward the capital 'D' token; steered, it spams 'D D D'.

L27n215.name: Mid-word fragments in names
L27n215.description: Negative pole. Fires on the second or later piece of a split name or word (Ik|ht|iyar, Zam|be|zi, Marr|akes, Gu|ising, e-|c|igs, P|ARR|ISE). Pushes toward 'is' and 'ig' pieces; steered, it outputs 'risrisris' or 'isis'.

L27n243.name: Word-completing later fragments
L27n243.description: Negative pole. Fires on the piece that continues a word after its first fragment (sar|com|as, scrib|bles, Zara|goza, ex|h|ales, Schenk|ensch|ans, th|robbed). Pushes toward suffix pieces 'ases' and 'ess'; steered, it spits 'essessess'.

L27n16.name: Determiner before a noun
L27n16.description: Negative pole. Fires on a determiner or quantifier that opens a noun phrase ('the' in the fundamental, 'an' offence, 'our' daily, 'every' man, 'without' external), where a head noun must come next. Pushes toward capitalized nouns like Address, Performance, Properties; steered, it drifts into 'Access Control System' spam.

L27n2321.name: 'qu' word-onset fragments
L27n2321.description: Fires on the first sub-token of words starting with 'qu' (Qu|inoa, qu|asar, qu|illed, qu|artile, qu|ell), and on some name onsets (Ja|én, Gu|imarães, Dev|onta). Pushes toward 'article'; steered, it repeats 'article article'.

L27n521.name: Short word-onset fragments
L27n521.description: Fires on the first sub-token of a longer word that starts with a short cluster (sl|ant, sl|ivered, st|ings, st|ave, Ad|oration, inter|com). Pushes toward 'image', 'message' and 'equation'; steered, it repeats 'image image' or 'story story'.

L27n1186.name: 're' and 'op' prefixes
L27n1186.description: Fires on a short prefix piece that opens a word split into tokens, mainly 're' ('well-researched', re|trieval, re|productive, re|cks) and 'op' (vas|op|ressin, Neo|op|latonic). Pushes toward 'product' and 'products'; steered, it spams 'Product product'.

L27n716.name: Verb right after modal
L27n716.description: Negative pole. Fires on the verb or adverb right after a modal or auxiliary ('will get', 'would have', 'has effectively', 'believed to have'). Pushes toward past-participle verbs like described, selected, identified; steered, it spams 'Selected selected'.

L27n3028.name: Proper-name onset fragments
L27n3028.description: Negative pole. Fires on the first sub-token of a proper name split into pieces (Laf|itte, Rams|es, Aj|inkya, Los| Alamos, Gh|af, Ch|om, Rob|). Pushes toward 'experiment'; steered, it spams 'Experiment experiment'.

L27n989.name: Verb-stem word fragments
L27n989.description: Fires on the first sub-token of a longer word, especially verb or adjective stems (puzz|ling, padd|ler, add|ing, fre|eware, short| courses, white| syndromes). Pushes toward 'list' and 'lists'; steered, it spams 'list list'.

L27n765.name: Inner ALL-CAPS word pieces
L27n765.description: Negative pole. Fires on the middle or later piece of an ALL-CAPS word or heading (MESS|NG|ER, E|LECT|RIC, CY|CLE, EXT. in screenplay headings, COR|RESP|ONDENCE). Pushes toward capital 'R' tokens; steered, it spams 'R R R'.

L27n2762.name: Word-onset fragments, 'inner'
L27n2762.description: Fires on a short word-start fragment or lone capital letter that opens a split word (contr|ived, contr|arious, d|ouches, D|ried, Wu|X|ing, sn, bre). Pushes toward 'inner', 'inside' and 'outer'; steered, it spams 'inner inner' or 'outer outer'.

L27n1304.name: Latin prefix word openers
L27n1304.description: Fires on the opening piece of a split word that starts with a common prefix, mainly 'con', 'cons', 'pres' and 'res' (con|struction, con|ventional, cons|cription, Pres|ently, res|ided, pros|elyted). Pushes toward 'sum' and 'sums'; steered, it spams 'Sum sum'.

L27n3042.name: Word-initial 'f' fragment
L27n3042.description: Fires on a lone 'f' or 'F' that opens a word split into tokens (f|ared, f|angs, f|athom, f|ashions, F|ossil, F|erry, Inf|initives). Pushes toward 'get' and 'gets'; steered, it spams 'get get'.

L27n820.name: Surname and place fragments
L27n820.description: Negative pole. Fires on the first or second piece of a surname or place name split into tokens (Sar|acen, Pis|ano, Be|cciu, St|amps, Ste|hn, Far|ah, Cropl|ey). Pushes toward 'name' and 'names'; steered, it spams 'Name name'.

L27n1442.name: Accented and odd characters
L27n1442.description: Fires on stray or accented characters and the fragment around them (´ in 'James J. Asher', ʻ in Hawaiʻi, � and ∂ glyphs, ri inside Siberia's IPA). Pushes toward accented letters ð, þ, é, ú; steered, it gives mostly normal prose with no clear spam.

L27n1811.name: Capital letter name onset
L27n1811.description: Negative pole. Fires on a lone capital letter or acronym start that opens a name (G in Van Gogh, GOCI, Gao, GHRH, J in JAXA, E in Euthanasia, L in László). Pushes toward closing braces '}' and '};'; steered, it spams '}}}}'.

L27n1261.name: Word-start fragment, writes 'cent'
L27n1261.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into several tokens, such as 'Col' in Colonic, 'Mult' in Multicultural, 'photoc' in photocatalyst, or 'Cost' in cost of goods. Pushes toward 'cent' and 'center' tokens; steered, it spams them.

L27n2718.name: Word-initial 'm', writes 'scale'
L27n2718.description: Fires on a word-initial 'm' or 'M' piece that starts a word or name, often when split from its continuation (M|idnite, Mos|he, m|ists). Pushes toward 'scale' tokens, but steered output stays near-normal prose.

L27n1295.name: Slot before past participle
L27n1295.description: Fires on the word just before an expected verb or past participle, mostly adverbs and auxiliaries: 'never' before 'been seen', 'still' before 'played', 'previously' before 'been denied', 'be' in 'should not be used'. Pushes toward 'generated', 'created', 'caused' and similar participles.

L27n514.name: Opening bracket or quote
L27n514.description: Fires on an opening parenthesis, quote mark, or URL separator just before an aside, unit, or quoted term, e.g. '(1 m)', '“safe-space”', '://'. Pushes toward 'u'-initial word fragments; steered, it produces 'uuuu' gibberish.

L27n2787.name: Mid-word fragment, predicts '-ion'
L27n2787.description: Fires on an unfinished middle piece of a long word split into subtokens, e.g. 'acc' in Maccabee, 'ath' in glutathione, 'mol' in molting, 'Dip' in Diplopoda. Pushes toward word-ending '-ion' and '-son' tokens; steered, it spams 'Son'.

L27n900.name: Infinitive/verb slot after 'to'
L27n900.description: Fires on the word right before an expected bare verb: 'to' before a verb ('lie quiet', 'continue', 'grow'), 'will' before 'be', 'they' or 'that' before a predicate. Pushes toward the bare verb 'select' and similar verbs; steered, it spams 'Select'.

L27n1730.name: Proper-name fragment, writes 'private'
L27n1730.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a capitalised name or rare word split into tokens, e.g. 'Mol' in Molotch, 'E' in Eunice, 'Kh' in Khadur, 'ach' in Dachau. Pushes toward 'private' and 'priv' tokens; steered, it spams 'Private'.

L27n2262.name: Word-start fragment, writes 'God'
L27n2262.description: Fires on a short word-initial fragment or letter that opens a multi-token word, e.g. 'f' in feta, 'sk' in skit, 'G' in Glee, 'sol' in solis. Pushes toward 'God' and 'god' tokens; steered, it spams 'God'.

L27n64.name: Inside a multi-word name
